question: _________ was among the 7 Recipients of the 2020 Tenzing Norgay National Award for land adventure, and received the award from then President Ram Nath Kovind during the 2021 National Sports Awards function.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priyanka Mangesh Mohite**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Priyanka Mohite was one of the seven recipients of the 2020 Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award for land adventure: 
 
• Mountaineer from Maharashtra who scaled some of the world's highest peaks, including Mt Everest, Mt Lhotse, and Mt.Makalu
 
• Other achievements
 
• First Indian woman to climb Mt Annapurna, the 10th highest mountain peak in the world
 
• 2020 Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award, 2017-2018 Maharashtra Government's Shiv Chhatrapati State award for adventure sports
 
• The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award is India's highest adventure sports honor, and is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lt. Col. Servesh Dhadwal:
 
 
• A member of the Indian Army, he was honored with the 2020 Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award in the air adventure category.
 
• He is a skilled skydiver and an instructor for the Indian Army Skydiving Team.
 
• Over his career, he has completed over 7,000 skydives and trained numerous personnel, including those in Special Forces.
 
• His contributions also extend to providing skydiving training for National Security Guards (NSG)​
 
 
 
• Jai Kishan: A
 
 
• Group Captain in the Indian Air Force, Jai Kishan has received the Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award twice. 
 
• His lifetime achievement award in 2021 recognizes his extensive contributions to adventure sports, including skydiving at the base of Mt. Everest and leading expeditions in the Sikkim Himalayas.
 
• He has six world records in adventure sports and has trained thousands in mountaineering and parachuting​
 
 
 
• Srikaanth Viswanathan:
 
 
• He is Honored with the award in the water adventure category in 2020, he is notable for completing the "Triple Crown" of open-water swimming, a prestigious feat involving swims across the English Channel, Catalina Channel, and around Manhattan Island. T
 
• his accomplishment highlights his remarkable endurance and dedication to water-based adventures​
